name: David E. Schoenwetter
office: Wrightwood Community Services District, Member, Board of Directors

items.text: David E. Schoenwetter is the appointed incumbent board president of the Wrightwood Community Services District. Appointed in August 2025, he has management experience from Santa Clara University and Disneyland Resort. His campaign says he has worked to improve financial transparency, operational oversight, and customer service. In March 2026, he defended a board vote not to renew the general manager’s contract, saying the board is 'tasked to see the big picture.'
